title: Create questions
subtitle: Upload a new document or select an existing one, pick the question types, and start generation. The generated questions will appear in the "My Questions" section.
deleteConfirm: Delete document "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
noDatasets: No datasets found. Upload a document below.
noStoredChunks: Document "{{name}}" has no stored chunks. Upload the source file again.
allChunksEmpty: All chunks are empty or too short.
allChunksRejected: All chunks were rejected by the gate.
methodHintRules: Split by headings and paragraphs; exercises and textbook apparatus are cut by rules. Fast, no model.
methodHintLayout: For PDF textbooks with a text layer: insets, captions and exercises are told apart by font and fill, run-in subheadings by emphasis. Other files fall back to rules.
methodHintSemantic: Default for textbooks. Chunk boundaries follow meaning via an embedding model on top of the PDF layout (on top of the rules for other files). Requires a configured embeddings service.
methodHintLlm: The model labels paragraphs (inset, exercise, table of contents…) and chunk boundaries. Most precise, but takes tens of minutes per textbook.
methodOnlyRulesForNormative: Legal documents are split by articles and items: only the rule-based method applies.
selectTypeHint: Select at least one question type — Generate stays disabled until you do.
pipelineFull: Full pipeline (chunk gate + generator + validator + auto refinement)
pipelineGate: Chunk gate + generator + validator (no auto refinement)
pipelineNoGate: Generator + validator (no chunk gate, no auto refinement)
duplicateName: A document named "{{name}}" already exists. Choose a different name or start generation from the existing document.
activeGeneration: Generation in progress{{queue}}. New runs can start in parallel.
gateQueuedStatus: Everything runs in the background now — you can safely close this page. Track progress on the Progress page (generation «{{queue}}»).
addedTasks: Added {{n}} tasks to generation «{{name}}». Open Progress to monitor.
chunkingFailed: Could not split the document. Try another file format.
zeroChunks: No chunks were produced. The document may be empty or unsupported.
scannedPdfHint: Could not extract text. This may be a scanned PDF — save as DOCX or a text PDF.
dropzoneHint: Drag a file here or click to choose
llmSegStats: windows: {{windows}}, by model: {{ok}}, by rules: {{fallback}}, truncated replies: {{truncated}}; paragraphs from {{source}}
